# Microtech Knives

> Microtech Knives (MTK Inc.) is a premier manufacturer of tactical and everyday carry knives, featuring innovative designs like OTF, automatic folders, and manual folders with proprietary technologies.

Microtech Knives specializes in high-performance cutting tools for tactical, law enforcement, and EDC applications. The company offers diverse knife types ranging from out-the-front (OTF) automatics to folding knives with advanced mechanisms like RAM-LOK and dual-action systems, along with premium collector models and collaborative partnerships.

## Key Topics

- OTF Knives
- Tactical Knives
- Automatic Folders
- Manual Folders
- RAM-LOK Technology
- SOCOM Elite
- Combat Troodon
- Everyday Carry (EDC)
- Dirac Series
- Hera II
- Cypher II
- Amphibian
- L.U.D.T.
- Apocalyptic Finish
- SureFire Collaborations

## Out-the-Front (OTF) Knives

- [OTF](https://microtechknives.com/collections/otfs): Microtech out-the-front knives including HALO, Ultratech, and Dirac models
- [Combat Troodon](https://microtechknives.com/collections/combat-troodon-newlist): Combat Troodon automatic OTF tactical knife for law enforcement and EDC
- [Dirac](https://microtechknives.com/collections/dirac-newlist): Dirac dual-action OTF knife with ergonomic chassis and glass breaker
- [Dirac Delta](https://microtechknives.com/collections/dirac-delta-newlist): Dirac Delta double-action OTF knife with robust size and glass breaker
- [Hera II](https://microtechknives.com/collections/hera-ii): Hera II dual-action OTF dagger knife with titanium pocket clip
- [Exocet](https://microtechknives.com/collections/exocet-newlist): Exocet automatic OTF money clip knife, California-legal daily carry
- [Glykon](https://microtechknives.com/collections/glykon-1): Glykon OTF knife with bayonet blade and ambidextrous pocket clip

## Automatic Folding Knives

- [Automatic Folders](https://microtechknives.com/collections/automatic-folders-new-list): Microtech automatic folding knives including SOCOM Elite variants
- [SOCOM Elite](https://microtechknives.com/collections/socom%C2%AE-elite): SOCOM Elite tactical knife collection with tanto and drop-point options
- [Cypher II](https://microtechknives.com/collections/cypher): Cypher II tactical knife collection with Apocalyptic finish variants

## Manual Folding Knives

- [Manual Folders](https://microtechknives.com/collections/manual-folders-1): Microtech manual folding knives featuring SOCOM Elite and RAM-LOK models
- [RAM-LOK Models](https://microtechknives.com/collections/ram-lok%E2%84%A2-models/Ram-Lok+RAM-LOK+RAM-LOK%E2%84%A2+Ram-Lok%E2%84%A2): Microtech RAM-LOK manual folders featuring innovative locking system
- [Stitch](https://microtechknives.com/collections/stitch/Stitch): Stitch pocket knife collection with RAM-LOK and serrated blade variants
- [Amphibian](https://microtechknives.com/collections/amphibian/Amphibian): Amphibian knife collection with RAM-LOK mechanism and G-10 handles
- [MSI](https://microtechknives.com/collections/msi%C2%AE/MSI%C2%AE+MSI%E2%84%A2+MSI+M.S.I.): MSI folding knife collection with Cerakote finish and aluminum handles

## Tactical Knife Collections

- [Folders](https://microtechknives.com/collections/all-folders): Microtech folding knives including SOCOM Elite and L.U.D.T. tactical models
- [L.U.D.T.](https://microtechknives.com/collections/l-u-d-t-%C2%AE/LUDT+L.U.D.T.%C2%AE+L.U.D.T.): L.U.D.T. tactical knife collection with Gen III variants and colors
